title: Anti-wrinkle LOL! Save your money.
text: Anti-wrinkle LOL! Save your money.. This tablecloth is a beautiful color gray. The fabric is of good thickness yet soft BUT it came with deep fold wrinkles that never fell out or even loosened after months on my kitchen table.  Today I washed on delicate in cold water.  I dried on extra low and the dang thing looks exactly as it did after removing from package.  Maybe anti wrinkle but not permanent deep fold lines.  I purchased this so as NOT to iron and this will require ironing not just pressing the wrong side.  If you want to iron then purchase this one as it will keep you busy!
